audit_type: Read-only local source-metadata join; no audio listening/decoding, model inference, download or SSH

first_32_training_calibration.note: These were deterministic calibration sources, not selected for expressive-event balance.

policy.fsd_validated_label: Target label exists in pinned FSD50K dev.csv and has at least two PP=1 votes and no NP=-1 vote in pinned ratings. Raw taxonomy/co-labels are not treated as verified targets.
policy.overlap: Labels can overlap. Distinct-source union is counted separately; do not sum label counts.
policy.source_vs_crop: These are weak recording-level annotations, not dense event start/end labels. Crop scoring intervals are not event intervals; no verified event-in-crop counts or seconds can be established from this metadata.
policy.unchanged: No training source selection, canonical panel, runner, checkpoint or weights changed.
policy.unknown: Missing specific audited event/style label does not establish that audio is nonexpressive.
policy.whisper_style: Explicit Thorsten whisper source classification joined by exact source ID and checked against whisper/ path.
policy.whistling: Previously reviewed human-whistling source descriptions joined by Freesound ID, with archived source evidence; not an FSD vote label.

principal_gaps: Selection split has no verified crying, human-whistle or Shout source; canonical panel has no verified crying, Giggle, Chuckle_and_chortle or Shout source (Yell is distinct).
Only four labeled crying recordings and three human-whistle recordings are present in the selected fit set; no dense event timing establishes how much of those events the chosen crops contain.
All fit and selection condition fields are null despite recoverable source labels; existing generic condition/None aggregates are not an expressive breakdown.
The first 32 training calibration sources contain no verified crying, screaming, human-whistle, giggling, chuckling, Shout, Yell or breathing label.
